notes.title: Skyblocker v1.3 Physics Update is Live!
notes.content: [p]Pitchfork Games is super excited to announce that our big physics update of Skyblocker is now live! This new update brings significant changes to how physics simulation is optimized, allowing for even more physics madness as you build your monumental tower![/p]

notes.title: v1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content: -Improved optimization of lighting for better performance.

notes.title: Skyblocker v1.07 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Optimized physics handling to lower impact of very large towers on framerate
-Slight improvements to appearance of certain UI modals

notes.title: v1.04 Skyblocker update
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where cursor could disappear after returning to the main menu
-Optimization of wind physics on blocks
-Improved detection of tower height
-Added option to change anti-aliasing method
-Slightly lowered controller sensitivity and adjusted response curve to be much smoother when using a gamepad
